Infiltrate.name: Infiltrate
Infiltrate.description: Your next #term[Attack] uses the target's Evasion as baseline when determining the thresholds for Heavy+ Hits, defaulting to the 5+ rule.

Lunge/Parry.name: Lunge/Parry
Lunge/Parry.description:
Lunge: You gain Reach(2) for this Attack. 
Parry: You gain Guard(1)

Well Balanced.name: Well Balanced
Well Balanced.description: When rolling for your next #term[Attack], you add a third unique #term(Attribute Die, key: Attribute Dice) to the roll, picking two of the three rolled dice to use.

Piercing Thrust.name: Piercing Thrust
Piercing Thrust.description: Your next Attack pierces all enemies in a line, using the same Attack Roll for each target.

Whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
Whirlwind.description: Your next Attack hits all Spaces within half of Reach, using the same Attack Roll for each target.

Ricochet.name: Ricochet
Ricochet.description: If your Attack hits, it bounces to a secondary target of your choice within half of the weapon's range, dealing 1 damage.

Curved Shot.name: Curved Shot
Curved Shot.description: Your next Attack ignores the Cover of a target.

Twin Arrows.name: Twin Arrows
Twin Arrows.description: Your next Attack is made against two targets within the weapon's Range, using the same Attack Roll.

Piercing Shot.name: Piercing Shot
Piercing Shot.description: Your attack pierces all enemies in a line, using the same Attack Roll for each target.

Hittable face.name: Hittable face
Hittable face.description: Goad an enemy into trying to attack you instead of an ally.

Joust.name: Joust
Joust.description: Roll a contested attack roll when passing an enemy, the highest attack resolves and the winner gets an attack of opportunity.

Sails.name: Sails
Sails.description: Vehicle has double speed if windy.

Radar.name: Radar
Radar.description: Vehicle can spend fuel to tell whats around hex.

Offroad Driver.name: Offroad Driver
Offroad Driver.description: No drawbacks from using suboptimal vehicle in difficult terrain.

Dubious Knowledge.name: Dubious Knowledge
Dubious Knowledge.description: When you fail on a roll to ascertain knowledge, learn two facts, one true and one false.

Risky Surgery.name: Risky Surgery
Risky Surgery.description: Before doing first aid, do a damaging attack to get a #boon(2) to the roll.

Flat Earther.name: Flat Earther
Flat Earther.description: You can see terrain in adjacent hexes from any height.

Born Salesman.name: Born Salesman
Born Salesman.description: You barter away goods at a higher price, and acquire them at a discount. Get Boon(1) when trying to haggle.

Forget I Said That.name: Forget I Said That
Forget I Said That.description: Make your conversation partner forget the current conversation.

Fast Talker.name: Fast Talker
Fast Talker.description: You have a certain way with words, and as such tend to lie better. Gain Boon(1) at lie checks

Secret Contact.name: Secret Contact
Secret Contact.description: You know a guy who knows a guy… Gain an insider in an organisation of your choosing. You can spend Scrap to get something illegal or difficult to find through the contact.

Talented.name: Talented
Talented.description: (Repeatable) Gain 1 Tiered Ability of your choice, as long as it's available to you normally.

Sturdy.name: Sturdy
Sturdy.description: You may reduce any Knockback you take by 1.

Momentum.name: Momentum
Momentum.description: All damage you deal with Heavy Weapons increase by 1.

Undefeatable.name: Undefeatable
Undefeatable.description: When rolling your Death Save you may use your Might die for the roll, instead of the standard d8.

Kratonian.name: Kratonian
Kratonian.description: You can one-hand two-handed weapons, and you can off-hand one-handed weapons.

Innate Magic.name: Innate Magic
Innate Magic.description: (Repeatable) Learn one spell from the spell list of a tier equal to or lower than your Insight Mod - 2.

Soothing Presence.name: Soothing Presence
Soothing Presence.description: As long as you're present for a Rest, all allies regain 1 bonus Grit from Relax, and 1 bonus Focus from Refocus.

Mana-resistant.name: Mana-resistant
Mana-resistant.description: Get Boon(1) when rolling for mana saturation.

Precision.name: Precision
Precision.description: Whenever you roll a Heavy+ Hit, you may add a roll of your Insight die to the result.
